coordinateContract.origin: palace-root local coordinates; facade base remains seated at palace y≈0.46

requiredFeatures: One continuous closed cathedral facade shell, sculpted as a deep solid with beveled silhouette and seated by overlap into the accepted entrance host. It must not read as a flat card or giant planar pair of wings.
One genuinely recessed pointed royal doorway cut into the shell with dark reveal walls, a purple double-door insert behind the face, and a thick but shallow masonry arch integrated into the opening.
One genuinely recessed rose opening cut into the upper gable, with purple/dark backplane and six radial gold divisions behind or flush with the face; no disk or panel may stand proud.
Four genuinely recessed honeycomb window openings cut into the same shell: two dominant lower and two subordinate upper. All four remain countable at 0, 45 and 315 degrees.

Two compact volumetric side buttresses/pylons and stepped gable shoulders break the silhouette while staying inside the accepted 3.38-unit palace width and not hiding the door or four window openings.
Two purple banners anchor into side buttress sockets and clear both the door and stair arrival.
Mesh remains multipart and named for material ownership, click/explode structure, later ornament, and construction-stage classification; no fused inert lump.
strictRejects: flat facade card or giant planar wings
rose or bay frames as standalone forward boxes
fewer than four countable bays at either 45 or 315 degrees
door hidden by a central slab or narrower than 1.05 world units
facade outside accepted macro width/height silhouette
open/non-manifold hero shell, reversed normals, degenerate triangles, or unattached parts
more than one bounded correction for this Blender family

capture.gate: Every required category at least 0.85; one bounded correction maximum. The accepted macro drift does not waive facade quality.
